{{short description|Indian coking coal mining company}} {{Use dmy dates|date=November 2018}} {{Use Indian English|date=November 2018}} {{Infobox company | name = Bharat Coking Coal Limited | type = [[Public company|Public]] [[Subsidiary]] | logo = Bharat Coming Coal Limited logo.jpg | image_size = | traded_as = {{NSE|BHARATCOAL}}
{{BSE|544678}} | key_people = Samiran Dutta (CMD) | industry = [[Coal]] | products = Coal | hq_location = [[Dhanbad]], India | founded = 1972 | area_served = [[Jharkhand]], [[West Bengal]] {{Cite web |title=BCCL Starts Coal Washery Operations in West Bengal |url=https://money.rediff.com/news/market/bccl-starts-coal-washery-operations-in-west-bengal/47776620260527 |access-date=2026-05-28 |website=Rediff}} | parent = [[Coal India]] | website = {{URL|https://bcclweb.in}} }} '''Bharat Coking Coal Limited''' ('''BCCL''') is an Indian [[coking coal]] mining company, headquartered in [[Dhanbad]].{{cite news |url=http://www.livemint.com/2012/06/22203051/The-dark-ages.html |title=The dark ages |date=22 June 2012 |author=Anindita Ghose |newspaper=Livemint |access-date=3 July 2012}} It is a [[subsidiary]] of [[Coal India Limited]], a public sector enterprise which is under the administrative control of the [[Ministry of Coal]]. It was incorporated in January 1972 to operate coking coal mines (214 in number) operating in the Jharia and Raniganj Coalfields and was taken over by the [[Government of India]] on 16 October 1971. BCCL contributes 50% of the total prime coking coal requirement of the steel sector.{{cite web|title=BCCL|url=http://www.bcclweb.in/?page_id=43}} The company operates 36 coal mines, which include eleven underground, sixteen open cast & nine mixed mines in the year 2020. The company runs eight [[Coal preparation plant|coal washeries]], and four are under construction. Mines are grouped into twelve areas for administration. BCCL is a major producer of prime coking coal (raw and washed) in India. Medium coking coal is produced in its mines in [[Dhanbad district|Mohuda]] and [[Barakar]] areas. In addition to the production of hard coke, BCCL operates washeries, sand gathering plants, a network of aerial [[Ropeway conveyor|ropeways]] for the transport of sand, and a [[Coalbed methane|coal bed methane]]-based power plant in [[Moonidih]]. ==History== BCCL incurred sustained losses from its incorporation in 1971 until it reported its first annual profit in 2005–06.{{cite news |title=BCCL out of the red after 25 years |url=https://www.telegraphindia.com/business/bccl-out-of-the-red-after-25-years/cid/805877 |access-date=19 January 2026 |work=The Telegraph India}} BCCL's [[net worth]] turned negative in 1994–95, and the company was referred to the [[Board for Industrial and Financial Reconstruction]] in 2001 for rehabilitation. A capital infusion of {{INRconvert|2539|c|mode=historical|year=2013}} by Coal India Limited in April 2013 revived BCCL from [[industrial sickness]].{{cite news |last1=Sengupta |first1=Debjoy |title=BCCL no longer sick after preferential shares issue to CIL |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/metals-mining/bccl-no-longer-sick-after-preferential-shares-issue-to-cil/articleshow/19468523.cms |access-date=19 January 2026 |work=The Economic Times |date=10 April 2013}} In January 2026, BCCL went public with an [[initial public offering]] structured as a [[Book building|book-built issue]] consisting solely of an offer for sale by its parent, Coal India Limited.{{cite news |title=Bharat Coking Coal IPO Day 3 update: Public issue nears 40x subscription; NIIs dominate, QIBs at 1.5x |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/ipo/bharat-coking-coal-ipo-day-3-update-public-issue-nears-40x-subscription-niis-dominate-qibs-at-1-5x-13769973.html |access-date=19 January 2026 |work=Moneycontrol}} ==Operations == A broad area-wise distribution of coalmines of Bharat Coking Coal Limited is given below:{{cite web |url=https://www.bcclweb.in/?page_id=6102&lang=en |title=Area |publisher=Bharat Coking Coal Limited |access-date=4 July 2021 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211010154808/https://www.bcclweb.in/?page_id=6102&lang=en |archive-date=10 October 2021 }}{{Failed verification|date=July 2021}} {| class="wikitable" style="width: 100%;" |- | style="width: 50%;
